scope: M03-P01-IP-004 Cloud IAM provider-managed identity-provider delete API slice
implementation_summary: Added a Cloud IAM API delete boundary for tenant-scoped provider-managed identity-provider removal.

Added domain directory delete semantics that validate provider id and tenant binding, return the deleted provider record for audit/idempotency replay, and reject providers still referenced by Cloud IAM principals.

Added API validation for non-empty path provider id, header/principal/body tenant binding, authorization on cloud.iam.identity_provider.delete, idempotent replay, missing-provider rejection, cross-tenant denial, tenant-drift rejection, and in-use conflict handling.
Added OpenAPI contract coverage for DELETE /v1/cloud/iam/identity-providers/{identity_provider_id} plus delete request and success response schemas.
Updated M03-P01/IP-004 status as provider-managed IdP create/list/update/delete API green while preserving provider runtime adapter/sync status and live-smoke gaps.

notes: The delete API is a write path and requires Idempotency-Key with replay protected by a canonical request fingerprint.

Tenant isolation is enforced before domain mutation by matching header tenant, authenticated principal tenant, and delete request tenant_id; the domain also rejects deleting a provider owned by another tenant.
The domain delete refuses providers still referenced by Cloud IAM principals, preventing dangling federated/external principal trust.
The ChangeSet explicitly does not claim provider sync adapter or live smoke completion.
